analytical_category: supervised regression prototype, strict time-based split, no random split

retention_rule.description: model retained when MAE improvement over baseline >= min_improvement_percent

congestion_bands.note: service-specific percentiles of PREDICTED ridership; analytical prototype categories only, not official KTMB classifications
congestion_bands.classification: predicted <= p60_threshold -> LOW; p60_threshold < predicted <= p85_threshold -> MODERATE; predicted > p85_threshold -> HIGH
